headline: Ten more codebase-patterns ports — detector count 36 → 46
summary: Bulk-ports every remaining applicable security / correctness detector from blamejs's catalog so the downstream surface inherits the framework's accumulated discipline in one pass. Covers decompression-bomb defense (`inflate-unzip-without-output-size-cap`, `zlib-decompress-not-via-safedecompress`), auth-path coercion (`buffer-from-string-on-auth-path`), JOSE / JWK confused-deputy (`jwk-import-without-alg-kty-check`, `jose-alg-switch-permissive-default`), SSRF metadata bypass (`ssrf-skip-without-textual-metadata-check`), JWT freshness gating (`optional-iat-age-check-no-required-freshness`), state-machine race conditions (`monotonic-terminal-state-overwrite-without-guard`), external-callback DoS (`external-callback-await-without-timeout`), and OpenMetrics counter exposition (`openmetrics-counter-family-name-mismatch`). All ports preserve their upstream `id` / `primitive` / `regex` / `reason` shape so the lineage stays diff-able against `lib/vendor/blamejs/test/layer-0-primitives/codebase-patterns.test.js`.

items.title: `inflate-unzip-without-output-size-cap` — RFC 1951 deflate bomb defense
items.body: Completes the gunzip-cap detector. `zlib.inflateSync` / `inflateRawSync` / `unzipSync` / `createInflate` / `createInflateRaw` / `createUnzip` without a `maxOutputLength` opt is the same amplification class as gzip. Uses the `requires` field to exempt files that name `maxOutputLength` elsewhere.

items.title: `zlib-decompress-not-via-safedecompress` — migration target
items.body: Flags every `zlib.*` decompression in lib/ that hasn't migrated to `b.safeDecompress(buf, { algorithm, maxOutputBytes, maxCompressedBytes })`. The framework primitive composes algorithm allowlist + ratio cap + bomb defense + audit emission in one call.

items.title: `buffer-from-string-on-auth-path` — prototype-pollution coercion defense
items.body: `Buffer.from(String(x))` on an auth-relevant input lets a polluted `toString()` redirect the byte sequence the comparison observes. Validate Buffer-or-string explicitly; refuse other shapes with a typed error.

items.title: `external-callback-await-without-timeout` — operator-callback DoS defense
items.body: Awaiting an operator-supplied callback (`_externalStore`, `_externalSink`, etc.) without a `b.safeAsync.withTimeout` bound means a stalled network call stalls the entire emit chain. Uses the `requires` field to exempt files that compose the timeout helper somewhere.

items.title: `monotonic-terminal-state-overwrite-without-guard` — state-machine race defense
items.body: State machines with a `done` (or terminal) flag whose async handler writes `state.done = true; state.X = ...` must check `if (state.done) return` first; a late-arriving handler otherwise clobbers an earlier terminal state.

items.title: `optional-iat-age-check-no-required-freshness` — token-freshness gate
items.body: `if (typeof X.iat === "number" && now - X.iat > maxAge)` short-circuits to no-check on missing iat. The verifier must refuse missing-iat first OR gate on `(iat is number OR server-nonce present)` before the age comparison.

items.title: `ssrf-skip-without-textual-metadata-check` — SSRF metadata-IP defense
items.body: Any SSRF-skip path (proxy short-circuit, operator-pinned IP, custom dnsLookup) must call `b.ssrfGuard.checkUrlTextual(url)` first; metadata IPs (169.254.169.254 / fd00:ec2::254) are never overridable.

items.title: `jwk-import-without-alg-kty-check` — JWK confused-deputy defense
items.body: `crypto.createPublicKey({ key: jwk, format: "jwk" })` without a sibling `_assertAlgKtyMatch(alg, jwk)` lets an attacker pass an RSA-marked key as EC (or vice versa). Validate alg / kty / use match BEFORE the import.

items.title: `jose-alg-switch-permissive-default` — alg-confusion defense
items.body: A `switch (alg)` with a permissive default (`return` / `break`) accepts unknown algorithm strings, opening HS256-as-RS256 and `none` attacks. The default branch must `throw` with a typed error.

items.title: `openmetrics-counter-family-name-mismatch` — exposition correctness
items.body: OpenMetrics counter `# HELP / TYPE / UNIT` metadata and `<name>_total` sample lines must use the same family identifier. Derive the exposed name once at the top of the per-metric loop.
